 Celeb style Celebs Looked Like They Were Plucked From A Fairytale at Academy Museum Gala Red Carpet
 Consider our jaws dropped. Oct. 18, 2026, 4:51 PM EDT Kimmy Yam
 Share Add TODAY to Google They look straight out of a storybook! 
 Celebrities on Oct. 17 attended the Academy Museum Gala, a benefit that raised funds for the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles. While the night included several standout moments — including a performance by superstar Taylor Swift — one of the major highlights was the red carpet, where actors, filmmakers and more strutted their best stuff. 
 The benefit, which is in its sixth year, is part of the museum’s efforts to “celebrate and preserve cinema,” according to a press release about the event. The gala, co-chaired by Tom Ford, Robert Rodriguez, Steven Spielberg, and Kate Capshaw, boasted attendees including the likes of Kim Kardashian, Demi Moore, Janelle Monae and many others. 
 From stunning, pearly gowns to striking velvet tuxedos, the star-studded event had no shortage of dreamy looks. 
 Check out some of the night’s most dazzling ensembles. 
 Taylor Swift
 Taylor Swift attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles Amy Sussman/Getty Images The “Patient Zero” songstress not only performed her “Toy Story 5” song, “I Knew It, I Know You,” at the event, but she also stunned — in a gray-blue floor-length custom Dior gown. She tied the look together with a pair of dangling, diamond earrings. 
 Demi Moore
 Demi Moore attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Actor Demi Moore rocked the red carpet in a long, black and pale purple gown by fashion house Standing Ground. The look, styled by Brad Goreski, was completed with a classic updo. 
 Kim Kardashian
 Kim Kardashian attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles Matt Winkelmeyer/FilmMagic Kim Kardashian showed up to the gala in a look reminiscent of Elizabeth Taylor and the Golden Age of Hollywood. Styled by celebrity “ image architect” Law Roach, Kardashian donned a 1951 vintage Balenciaga gown, along with a diamond choker and sparkling earrings. 
 Janelle Monae
 Janelle Monáe attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Matt Winkelmeyer/FilmMagic/Getty Images Singer and actor Janelle Monae arrived in one of the most artistic ensembles of the night. Monae wore a sequined deep purple-and-black ombré gown, complete with a massive butterfly accent by designer Robert Wun. Her matching sheer gloves added an extra special accent to the look.
 Connor Storrie
 Connor Storrie attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images “Heated Rivalry” star Connor Storrie stunned in a long, black Saint Laurent coat and slacks. The look was tied together with a black, satin scarf and two pairs of small hoop earrings. 
 Camila Cabello 
 Camila Cabello attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Frazer Harrison/WireImage/Getty Singer Camila Cabello strutted her stuff in a tight, black corset that was paired with mesh skirt from Dolce & Gabbana’s 1998 Spring collection. The romantic look was tied together with a dreamy bun and long, flowing scarf that trailed behind her. 
 Eddie Redmayne
 Eddie Redmayne attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Actor Eddie Redmayne walked the red carpet in a Giorgio Armani royal blue, velour button-down shirt paired with pleated navy pants. 
 Cole Escola
 Cole Escola attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images “Oh, Mary!” creator Cole Escola showed up to the gala in a stunning black Chanel gown and cape that featured a giant black bow. The look was tied together with dangling, emerald earrings and a black clutch. 
 Alexander Skarsgard
 Alexander Skarsgård attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Actor Alexander Skarsgard is known for his unique outfits and this particular look was no exception. The “Wicker” star, styled by Harry Lambert, rocked a white, ruffled button-down with a black flower accent. 
 Bird Runningwater
 Bird Runningwater attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Taylor Hill/FilmMagic/Getty Producer Bird Runningwater rocked the red carpet in a floor-length, long-sleeved cape, white ruffled button-down and, of course, an infectious smile. 
 Peyton Lee
 Peyton Elizabeth Lee attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Taylor Hill/FilmMagic/Getty Images Actor Peyton Elizabeth Lee showed up to the dazzling event in a dreamy, Marco Rambaldi off-white dress. 
 Amandla Stenberg
 Amandla Stenberg attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Photo by Amy Sussman/Getty Images Amandla Stenberg strutted the carpet, wearing a sheer, deep-V-neck gown from Zimmermann that was adorned with butterfly and flower appliques. 
 Tracee Ellis Ross 
 Tracee Ellis Ross attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Actor Tracee Ellis Ross, who was styled by Law Roach, lit up the carpet with a vibrant, orange number by Balenciaga. Her hair was pulled into a tight bun in contrast to the free-flowing dress. 
 Inde Navarrette
 Inde Navarrette attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Actor Inde Navarrette rocked a polka dot Schiaparelli dress that featured a bubble-shaped skirt. She tied the couture look together with some black, pointed-toe stilettos. 
 Ava DuVernay 
 Ava DuVernay attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images
 Director Ava DuVernay wore an off-the-shoulder, powder blue Louis Vuitton gown, reminiscent of Cinderella. 
 Kendall Jenner 
 Kendall Jenner attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Matt Winkelmeyer/FilmMagic Model Kendall Jenner wore an all-polka dot ensemble from Valentino. The dress included a deep thigh split and polka dot bows. The look was tied together with a pair of polka dot shoes. 
 Pamela Anderson 
 Pamela Anderson attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Pamela Anderson wore a two-piece Carolina Herrera number that featured a white button down shirt and a long, sage green skirt. 
 Jaafar Jackson
 Jaafar Jackson attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images “Michael” star Jaafar Jackson strutted his stuff in a classic, velvet tux look. 
 Anna Kendrick
 Anna Kendrick attends the 6th Annual Academy Museum Gala at Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 17, 2026 in Los Angeles. Amy Sussman/Getty Images Actor Anna Kendrick wore a striking black swan-esque gown from designer Georges Chakra that featured black appliques, a plunging neckline and flared hips. 
 Share Add TODAY to Google Kimmy Yam Kimmy Yam is a reporter for NBC Asian America.
